title: Concept: A declared name is one edit away from `actix-web`
description: Cargo.toml declares a declared crate name in Cargo.toml within one edit of `actix-web`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Cargo resolves these names against the registry, so a name that only looks like the intended crate compiles foreign code into the binary. The name this rule expects is `actix-web`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: Cargo resolves these names against the registry, so a name that only looks like the intended crate compiles foreign code into the binary. The name this rule expects is `actix-web`.
